verdict:
TECHNICAL + SYNC: PASS on every measurable spec, with one checklist fix only partly done (s08 bar), a stale root deliverable, and a few small caption-frame and SFX nits.

What passes:
- **File:** out/final.mp4 is 14,502,382 B (under 15,000,000). H.264 High@4.0, yuv420p, 720x1280, 24 fps, moov before mdat. Tagged bt709/bt709/bt709/tv.
- **Durations:** video is 7660 frames = 319.167 s, AAC is 319.185 s and timeline_play is 319.185 s. The master has 7661 frames; -shortest drops the last one (18 ms, harmless).
- **Audio:** loudnorm summary gives -16.5 LUFS integrated, LRA 5.5, true peak -1.1 dBTP (ebur128: -16.4 LUFS, -1.1 dBFS TP). It passes, but with only 0.1 dB of margin.
- **Voice placement:** all 62 wav_play lines cross-correlate against the final AAC at exactly 0 ms from their timeline_play starts, with normalised correlation 0.84-0.95.
- **Lip-sync:** checked in final.mp4 for s02b04, s04b03, s04b04, s05b01, s06b07, s07b03, s08b02, s12b01, s14b08, s17b03 and s17b04. Mouths are open on the loudest frames and closed in mid-line gaps: 53.00 inside 'scares me. | It's not', 91.40 inside 'I can't. | I'm sorry', 29.60 inside 'Fear? | What'. They are also closed before and after lines (147.52, 274.99). The inner line s13b02 has no lip data, which is correct.
- **Cuts:** 83 cuts detected in final.mp4 match data/cuts_play.json exactly, apart from one soft cut at 179.29 my threshold missed.
- **Frame 0:** the bright title still with no caption, and it matches thumbnail.png.
- **s01 title:** fully gone by 3.40; the first caption fades in at 3.60.
- **s14 music-note glyph:** fully visible to the right of the caption during 'The Void, filled with bits and pieces of meaning.' (checked 213.8 and 215.2).
- **Line boundaries:** a frame-difference scan at all 125 warp knots found only caption swaps, a scripted blink (92.62), the hands-off snap on 'Fear,' (98.9-99.0) and the fast tear-wipe at 311.4. Rendered frame by frame, none is a warp glitch.
- **Ending:** clean. Lamp off, no caption, audio decays to -80 dB by 319.1.
- **Heartbeats:** no on-screen beat to sync to. The tempo of the s13 and s05 loops was corrected for the speed-up.
- **Captions:** out/subtitles.srt matches subtitles.json for all 76 captions. Every caption covers its voice span except two deliberate early ends (s08b01 ends at the cut; s13b06 ends at 199.05).

Remaining problems are listed below. The s08 bar no longer splits the mouth down the middle, but it still sits on the right corner of Fear's open mouth through 'Please don't leave…', with the corner showing again past the bar.

issues.problem:
Three captions blank out for one frame (hard off/on with no fade, because JOIN skips the fades):
- Frame 1555 (64.792) is the first frame after the cut. It has no caption, because 'We always come back.' starts at 64.792, 0.3 ms after the frame time 64.79167. The caption therefore appears one frame after the cut.
- Frame 2881 (120.042): the same thing for 'And I felt sadness.' (start 120.042 vs cut 120.04167).
- Frame 6238 (259.917): 'The Void stood there,' ends at 259.909, and 'with galaxies twinkling…' starts at the cut, 259.958. One empty frame shows between two low captions.
All three are confirmed in final.mp4. Cause: tools/build_subtitles.py writes cut-snapped times rounded to 3 decimals, which can land after the frame time. drawSubtitles also never fills gaps shorter than JOIN; it only removes the fades.
issues.fix: In tools/build_subtitles.py, write snapped times as floor(frame_time*1000)/1000 (e.g. 64.791, 120.041, 259.958). Chain any gap under 2 frames (0.084 s) by setting prev.end = next.start: s05b01 end 64.764→64.791, s09b01 end 120.03→120.041, s16b03.0 end 259.909→259.958. Optionally, in src/subtitles.mjs drawSubtitles, keep drawing caption i while t < cs[i+1].start when the two are joined. Then confirm frames 1555, 2881 and 6238 show a caption.

issues.problem: The CEO's walk-in footsteps are one 4-hit sample at a fixed rate (at 105.032, rate 1.17, until 106.637). The scene's visible foot contacts are about 105.14, 105.65 and 106.20; I computed them from ceoWalk and the walk phase, and the rendered feet are widest at 105.59-105.64 and 106.20. The walk slows as the CEO arrives, but the sample's hits stay evenly spaced: 105.100, 105.588, 106.058, 106.528. The 3rd step is heard about 145 ms (3.5 frames) before the foot lands. The speed-up compensation in tools/collect_sfx.mjs never fires for this event: it measures the warp slope only in the 0.4 s after the onset, which falls in the silent stretch before s08b01. The rate therefore stayed 1.17. The feet are low in frame, so this is minor.
issues.fix: In s08_the_cage.mjs sfx, replace the single CEO footsteps event with one event per contact, as s02 does. The story-time contacts are scene.start+0.091, s08b01+0.164 and s08b01+0.803. Set each event's at = contact - 0.07, until = contact + 0.40, fade 0.12, gain -14, and keep the existing Fear patter. Re-run node tools/collect_sfx.mjs, python3 audio/mix.py and tools/encode.sh.

issues.problem: The fix for blinking between back-to-back captions is incomplete. JOIN=0.2 only turns off the fades. activeCaption() still returns -1 inside the gap, so captions closer than 0.2 s still drop out as hard cuts at full opacity. Confirmed in out/final.mp4: frames 147-149 (6.125-6.208 s) show no caption between 'So, I was having a memory,' (ends 6.12) and 'of the first story…' (starts 6.25, on the cut), so the first caption pops off 3 frames before the cut. Frame 6238 (259.917) has no caption in the middle of the sentence 'The Void stood there, / with galaxies twinkling…', one frame before the cut at 259.958. Frame 1555 (64.792, the cut frame) is blank between 'Out! Everybody out!' and 'We always come back.' (both top), and so is frame 2881 (120.042) between s09b01 and s09b02. There are two causes. (a) The builder's bridging step uses the next caption's start from before that caption is snapped to the cut. s01b02:0 was bridged to roughly 6.12, then s01b02:1 moved to 6.25, and the same happened with s16b03:0 at 259.909 against 259.958. (b) Cut-snapped starts are rounded up at 3 decimals (64.7917→64.792, 120.0417→120.042), which puts them after the cut frame's time f/24.
issues.fix: src/subtitles.mjs drawSubtitles: when activeCaption(t) < 0, find i with cs[i].end <= t < cs[i+1].start and cs[i+1].start - cs[i].end < JOIN, and draw cs[i] at alpha 1 so it holds until the next caption takes over. tools/build_subtitles.py: run the cut-snapping of every start in its own pass before the end/bridge pass, and store cut-snapped times at frame precision (round(cut*24)/24 written with 4 decimals, e.g. 64.7917). Alternatively compare with t >= start - 1e-3. Resulting data: s01b02:0 end 6.12→6.25; s05b01 end 64.764→64.7917 and s05b02 start →64.7917; s09b01 end 120.03→120.0417 and s09b02 start →120.0417; s16b03:0 end 259.909→259.9583 and s16b03:1 start →259.9583. Re-render and confirm that frames 147-149, 1555, 2881 and 6238 carry a caption.

issues.problem: s13b03:0 'My fear thought the Void / had had enough' runs at 18.8 cps (39 chars in 2.07 s, 182.917-184.986). It is the only caption above the ~17 cps limit, and the v2 review's request to rebalance this split was not applied. The split falls in continuous speech, so the caption can't be held longer. The narration's only real pause is the comma after 'complaining' (voice gap 186.31-186.78).
issues.fix: Add split_after {"s13b03": ["complaining,"]} to data/subtitle_overrides.json. That gives 'My fear thought the Void had had enough of its complaining,' at about 182.917-186.73 (59 chars, 15.5 cps) and 'and would destroy it.' at about 186.73-188.39 (12.6 cps), with the break in the real pause. In layout(), add a +60 penalty when the words on both sides of a break are identical. The first caption then breaks as 'My fear thought the Void had had / enough of its complaining,' (519.6 px, which fits in 520) rather than 'Void had / had enough'.

A simulation against all 76 captions changes exactly these four: 'I told myself it was / the responsible thing to do.', 'And the Void stared into / the screen of my consciousness.' verdict: The captions are close to done. Timing, text and safe zones are clean. Two things remain worth fixing: a 1-3 frame dropout where back-to-back captions meet, and one bad placement (s08b02 sits on the TIME-OUT sign). What I checked: (1) Audio sync. Cross-correlating each line WAV with the decoded final mix gives 0 ms offset for all 62 lines, so the voice-energy edges are the heard edges. Every caption starts between 0.05 s before and 0.03 s after its first voiced frame, or on a shot cut just before it (s01b02:1 is +0.08 s, on the 6.25 cut). Every caption stays at least 0.25 s past its last voiced frame, with two deliberate exceptions. s08b01 ends at the 107.44 cut, as 'cage' finishes. s13b06 fades out over 198.93-199.05 while 'Void' runs to about 199.12. That one is needed: on caption-free renders the hood opening reaches the upper box's top edge at about 199.08-199.12. The last line s20b03 holds to 312.85. (2) Cuts. No caption starts on the outgoing shot 1-3 frames before a cut. Cut-snapped captions start on the cut or one frame after it. s05b03 starts 7 frames before the 66.5 cut, but that is on the voice and over clean floor. Two captions spill 5-7 frames past a cut (s07b03, s12b03). (3) Placement. The lowest box edge is y=1072 (the bottom-15% line is 1088) and the rightmost is x=626. On full-size frames I checked every Fear and Consciousness line and all multi-shot captions; none covers eyes or mouths. s04 is now low, under Fear. s06b01's low half sits about 70 px below the emotions' mouths in the console shot. The s12b03 sleeve balloon and the s17b04 cheek overlap are gone. The new tints, Fear #c7b5ff and Consciousness #ffd98c, read clearly apart for off-screen lines such as 'It's causing turmoil.' and 'Fear,'. (4) Text. All 62 spoken lines are captioned, and the text and speaker match screenplay.json exactly. The ASR differences ('imagine', 'a huge', 'and after that', 'it's') are Whisper artifacts. out/subtitles.srt matches subtitles.json for all 76 captions. (5) Reading speed. Every caption is at or under 15.9 cps except s13b03:0 at 18.8. Previous report (qa_v2.json): resolved are s08b01 running past the cut, the pre-cut starts, the early second halves (6.25/26.33/53.33/300.99, against voice 6.17/26.38/53.38/301.04), the s03b03 split, captions ending before the voice, the s02b04 split, the s10b01 blink, the s13b06 tilt overlap, the s14 music-note glyph (now well clear of the box), the speaker tints, the title overlap (title gone by 3.58, caption fades in at 3.60) and the AAC true peak (now -1.1 dBTP, -16.4 LUFS). Partly resolved: back-to-back blinking (4 places still drop 1-3 frames), dangling line breaks (4 remain), and the s08 bar on Fear's mouth (it still clips the right quarter of the mouth on 'Please'). Not applied: the s13b03 rebalance. The root deliverable is still v1 with no captions. Work files are in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-game1/431c6cf3-9061-55b0-82f1-1947bb12410c/scratchpad: capanal.json, sim.py, blink.png, spill.png, s08c.png, tilt.png, mouth2.png and exit2.png.
